author: atillaustundag4
quote: In my opinion GTA 5 has a much better story than GTA 6. GTA 5 had three different main characters with their own stories and goals. This made the game more interesting and exciting. Grand Theft Auto has always been about gangs, crime, robberies, betrayal and power. I have nothing against relationships in GTA but I think the relationship between Jason and Lucia gets too much attention. I want to experience an exciting gangster story and not a relationship simulator. A relationship should be part of the story and not the main focus. That is why I think GTA 5 feels more like a real GTA game.
